original: [vajjālaggaṁ]
savvannuvayaṇapaṅkayaṇivāsiṇiṁ paṇamiūṇa suyadēviṁ ।
dhammāitivaggajuyaṁ suyaṇāṇa suhāsiyaṁ vōcchaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.1
amayaṁ pāiyakavvaṁ paḍhiuṁ sōuṁ ca jē na jāṇanti ।
kāmassa tattavatiṁ kuṇanti tē kaha na lajjanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.2
vivihakaïviraïyāṇaṁ gāhāṇaṁ varakulāṇi ghēttūṇa ।
raïyaṁ vajjālaggaṁ vihiṇā jayavallahaṁ nāma ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.3
ēkkatthē patthāvē jattha paḍhijjanti paüragāhāō ।
taṁ khalu vajjālaggaṁ vajja tti ya paddhaī bhaṇiyā ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.4
ēyaṁ vajjālaggaṁ savvaṁ jō paḍhaï avasarammi sayā ।
pāiyakavvakaī sō hōhii taha kittimantō ya ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.5
[sōyāravajjāśrōtr̥paddhatiḥ]
dukkhaṁ kīraï kavvaṁ kavbammi kaē paüñjaṇā dukkhaṁ ।
santē paüñjamāṇē sōyārā dullahā hunti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.6
sakkayamasakkayaṁ pi hu atthō sōyārasaṅgamavasēṇa ।
appuvvarasavisēsaṁ jaṇēi jaṁ taṁ mahacchariyaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.7
muttāhalaṁ va kavvaṁ sahāvavimalaṁ suvaṇṇasaṅghaḍiyaṁ ।
sōyārakaṇṇakuhararammi payaḍiyaṁ pāyaḍaṁ hōi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.8
[gāhāvajjāgāthāpaddhatiḥ]
addhakkharabhaṇiyāiṁ nūṇaṁ savilāsamuddhahasiyāiṁ ।
addhacchipēcchiyāiṁ gāhāhi viṇā na najjanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.9
sālaṅkarāhi salakkhaṇāhi annannarāyarasiyāhiṁ ।
gāhāhi paṇaïṇīhi ya khijjaï cittaṁ aïntīhiṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.10
ēyaṁ ciya navari phuḍaṁ hiyayaṁ gāhāṇa mahiliyāṇaṁ ca ।
aṇarasiēhi na labbhaï daviṇaṁ va vihīṇapuṇṇēhiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.11
sacchandiyā sarūvā sālaṅkārā ya sarasa--ullāvā ।
varakāmiṇi vva gāhā gāhijjantī rasaṁ dēi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.12
gāhāṇa rasā mahilāṇa vibbhamā kaïjaṇāṇa ullāvā ।
kassaṁ na haranti hiyayaṁ bālāṇa ya mammaṇullāvā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.13
savvō gāhāu jaṇō vīsatthō bhaṇaï savvagōṭhṭhīsu ।
paramatthō jō tāṇaṁ sō nāō mahachaïllēhiṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.14
gāhā ruaï varāī sikkijjantī gavāralōēhiṁ ।
kīraï luñcapaluñcā jaha gāī mandadōhēhiṁ ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.15
gāhē bhajjihisi tumaṁ ahavā lahuyattaṇaṁ vi pāvihisi ।
gāmāradantadiḍhakaḍhiṇapīḍiyā ucchulaṭṭhi vva ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.16
gāhāṇaṁ gīyāṇaṁ tantīsaddāṇa pōḍhamahilāṇaṁ ।
tāṇaṁ ciya sō daṇḍō jē tāṇa rasaṁ na yāṇanti ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.17
chandaṁ ayāṇa māṇēhi jā kiyā sā na hōi ramaṇijjā ।
kiṁ gāhā aha sēvā ahavā gāhā vi sēvā vi ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.18
[kavvavajjākāvyapaddhatiḥ]
cintāmandaramanthāṇamanthiē vittharammi atthāhē ।
uppajjanti kaīhiyayasāyarē kavvarayaṇāiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.19
rayaṇujjalapayasōhaṁ taṁ kavvaṁ jaṁ tavēi paḍivakkhaṁ ।
purisāyantavilāsiṇirasaṇādāmaṁ miva rasantaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.20
pāiyakavvammi rasō jō jāyaï taha ya chēyamaṇiēhiṁ ।
uyayasya ya vāsiyasīyalassa tittiṁ na vaccāmō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.21
kaha kaha vi raēi payaṁ maggaṁ pulaēi chēyamāruhaï ।
cōrō vva kaī atthaṁ ghēttūṇaṁ kaha vi nivvahaï ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.22
saddāvasaddabhīrū paē paē kiṁ pi kiṁ pi cintantō ।
dukkhōhi kaha vi pāvaï cōrō atthaṁ kaī kavvaṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.23
saddapalōṭṭaṁ dōsēhi vajjiyaṁ sulaliyaṁ phuḍaṁ mahuraṁ
puṇṇēhi kaha vi pāvaï chandē kavvaṁ kalattaṁ ca ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.24
aṇavarayabahalarōmañcakañcuyaṁ jaṇiyajaṇamaṇāṇandaṁ ।
jaṁ na dhuṇāvaï sīsaṁ kavvaṁ pēmmaṁ ca kiṁ tēṇa ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.25
sō sōhaï dūsantō kaïyaṇaraïyāi vivihakavvāiṁ ।
jō bhañjiūṇa avayaṁ1 annapayaṁ sundaraṁ dēi ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.26
atthakkō rasarahiō dēsavihīṇō'ṇuṇāsiō turiō ।
muhavañcaṇō virāō ēē dōsā paḍhantassa ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.27
dēsiyasaddapalōdr̥ṁ mahurakkharachandasaṇṭhiyaṁ laliyaṁ ।
phuḍaviyaḍapāyaḍatthaṁ pāiyakavvaṁ paḍhēyavvaṁ ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.28
laliē mahurakkharaē juvaījaṇavallahē sasiṅgārē ।
santē pāiyakavvē kō sakkaï sakkayaṁ paḍhiuṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.29
abuhā buhāṇa majjhē paḍhanti jē chandalakkhaṇavihūṇā ।
tē bhamuhākhaggaṇivāḍiyaṁ pi sīsaṁ na lakkhanti ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.30
pāiyakavvassa namō pāiyakavvaṁ ca nimmiyaṁ jēṇa ।
tāhaṁ ciya paṇamāmō paḍhiūṇa ya jē vi thāṇanti ॥13 ॥ // VajLag.31
[sajjaṇavajjāsajjanapaddhatiḥ]
mahaṇammi sasī mahaṇammi suratarū mahaṇasambhavā lacchī ।
suyaṇō uṇa kahasu mahaṁ na yāṇimō kattha sambhūō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.32
suyaṇō suddhasahāvō maïlijjantō vi dujjaṇajaṇēṇa ।
chārēṇa dappaṇō viya ahiyayaraṁ nimmalō hōi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.33
suyaṇō na kuppaï cciya aha kuppaï maṅgulaṁ na cintēi ।
aha cintēi na jampaï aha jampaï lajjirō hōi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.34
daḍharōsakalusiyassa vi suyaṇassa suhāu vippiyaṁ kattō ।
rāhumuhammi vi sasiṇō kiraṇā amayaṁ ciya muyanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.35
diṭṭhā haranti dukkhaṁ jampantā dēnti sayalasōkkhāiṁ ।
ēyaṁ vihiṇā sukayaṁ suyaṇā jaṁ nimmiyā bhuvaṇē ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.36
na hasanti paraṁ na thuvanti appayaṁ piyasayāi jampanti ।
ēsō suyaṇasahāvō namō namō tāṇa purisāṇaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.37
akaē vi kaē vi piē piyaṁ kuṇantā jayammi dīsanti ।
kayavippiē vi hu piyaṁ kuṇanti tē dullahā suyaṇā ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.38
savvassa ēha payaī piyammi uppāiē piyaṁ kāuṁ ।
suyaṇassa ēha payaī akaē vi piē piyaṁ kāuṁ ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.39
pharusaṁ na bhaṇasi bhaṇiō vi hasasi hasiūṇa jampasi piyāiṁ ।
sajjaṇa tujjha sahāvō na yāṇimō kassa sāricchō ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.40
nēcchasi parāvayāraṁ parōvayāraṁ ca niccamāvahasi ।
avarāhēhi1 na kuppasi suyaṇa namō tuha sahāvassa ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.41
dōhiṁ ciya pajjattaṁ bahuēhi vi kiṁ guṇōhi suyaṇassa ।
vijjupphuriyaṁ2 rōsō mittī pāhāṇarēha vva ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.42
rē rē kalikālamahāgaïnda galagajjiyassa kō kālō ।
ajja vi supurisakēsarikisōracalaṇaṅkiyā puhavī ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.43
dīṇaṁ abbhuddhariuṁ pattē saraṇāgaē piyaṁ kāuṁ ।
avaraddhēsu vi khamiuṁ suyaṇō cciya navari jāṇēi ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.44
vē purisā dharaï dharā ahavā dōhiṁ pi dhāriyā dharaṇī ।
uvayārē jassa maī uvayariyaṁ jō na pamhusaï ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.45
paḍivajjanti na suyaṇā aha paḍivajjanti kaha vi dukkhēhiṁ ।
patthararēha vva samā maraṇō vi na annahā hōi ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.46
sēlā calanti palaē majjāyaṁ sāyarā vi mēllanti ।
suyaṇā tahiṁ pi kālē paḍivannaṁ nēya siḍhilanti ॥ 16 ॥ // VajLag.47
candaṇataru vva suyaṇā phalarahiyā jaï vi nimmiyā vihiṇā ।
taha vi kuṇanti paratthaṁ niyayasarīrēṇa lōyassa ॥ 17 ॥ // VajLag.48
[dujjaṇavajjādurjanapaddhatiḥ]
hayadujjaṇassa vayaṇaṁ nirantaraṁ bahalakajjalacchāyaṁ ।
saṅkuddhaṁ bhiuḍijuyaṁ kayā vi na hu nimmalaṁ diṭṭhaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.49
thaddhō vaṅkaggīvō avañciō visamadiṭṭhiduppēcchō ।
ahiṇavariddhi vva khalō sūlādinnu1 vva paḍihāi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.50
nahamāsabhēyajaṇaṇō dummuhaō atthikhaṇḍaṇasamatthō ।
taha vi hu majjhāvaliō namaha khalō naharaṇasaricchō ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.51
akulīṇō dōmuhaō tā mahurō bhōyaṇaṁ muhē jāva ।
muraü vva khalō jiṇṇāmmi bhōyaṇē virasamārasaï ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.52
niddhammō guṇarahiō ṭhāṇavimukkō ya lōhasambhūō ।
vindhaï jaṇassa hiyayaṁ pisuṇō bāṇu vva laggantō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.53
jammē vi jaṁ na hūyaṁ na hu hōsaï jaṁ ca jammala kkhē vi ।
taṁ jampanti taha cciya pisuṇā jaha hōi sāricchaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.54
guṇiṇō guṇēhi vihavēhi vihaviṇō hōntu gavviyā nāma ।
dōsēhi navari gavvō khalāṇa maggō cciya aüvvō ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.55
santaṁ na dēnti vārēnti dēntayaṁ dinnayaṁ pi hāranti ।
aṇimittavaïriyāṇaṁ khalāṇa maggō cciya aüvvō ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.56
paravivaraladdhalakkhē cittalaē bhīsaṇē jamalajīhē ।
vaṅkaparisakkirē gōṇasē vva pisuṇē suhaṁ kattō ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.57
asamatthamantatantāṇa kulavimukkāṇa mōyahīṇāṇaṁ ।
diṭṭhāṇa kō na bīhaï vintarasappāṇa va khalāṇaṁ ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.58
ēyaṁ ciya bahulāhō jīvijjaï jaṁ khalāṇa majjhammi ।
lāhō jaṁ na ḍasijjaï bhuyaṅgaparivēḍhiē calaṇē ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.59
na sahaï abbhatthaṇiyaṁ asaï gayāṇaṁ pi piṭṭhimaṁsāiṁ ।
daṭṭhūṇa bhāsuramuhaṁ khalasīhaṁ kō na bīhēi ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.60
mā vaccaï vīsambhaṁ pamuhē bahukūḍakavaḍabhariyāṇaṁ ।
nivvattiya kajjaparaṁmuhāṇa suṇayāṇa va khalāṇaṁ ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.61
jēhiṁ ciya ubbhaviyā jāṇa pasāēṇa niggayapayāvā ।
samarā ḍahanti viñjhaṁ khalāṇa maggō cciya aüvvō ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.62
sarasā vi dumā dāvāṇalēṇa ḍajjhanti sukkhasaṁvaliyā ।
dujjaṇasaṅgē pattē suyaṇō vi suhaṁ na pāvēi ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.63
khalasajjaṇāṇa dōsā guṇā ya kō vaṇṇiuṁ taraï lōē ।
jaï navari nāyarāō dōhiṁ jīhāsahassēhiṁ ॥ 16 ॥ // VajLag.64
[mittavajjāmitrapaddhatiḥ]
ēkkaṁ ciya salahijjaï diṇēsadiyahāṇa navari nivvahaṇaṁ ।
ājamma ēkkamēkkēhi jēhi virahō cciya na diṭṭhō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.65
paḍivannaṁ diṇayaravāsarāṇa dōṇhaṁ akhaṇḍiyaṁ suhaï ।
sūrō na diṇēṇa viṇā diṇō vi na hu suravirahammi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.66
mittaṁ payatōyasamaṁ sāricchaṁ jaṁ na hōi kiṁ tēṇa ।
ahiyāēi milantaṁ āvaï āvaṭṭaē paḍhamaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.67
taṁ mittaṁ kāyavvaṁ jaṁ kira vasaṇammi dēsakālammi ।
ālihiyamittibāullayaṁ va na paraṁmuhaṁ ṭhāi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.68
taṁ mittaṁ kāyavvaṁ jaṁ mittaṁ kālakambalīsarisaṁ ।
uyaēṇa dhōyamāṇaṁ sahāvaraṅgaṁ na mēllēi ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.69
saguṇāṇa nigguṇāṇa ya garuyā pālanti jaṁ ji paḍivannaṁ ।
pēcchaha vasahēṇa samaṁ harēṇa vōlāviō appā ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.70
chijjaü sīsaṁ aha hōu bandhaṇaṁ cayaü savvahā lacchī ।
paḍivannapālaṇē supurisāṇa jaṁ hōi taṁ hōu ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.71
diḍhalōhasaṅkalāṇaṁ annāṇa vi vivihapāsabandhāṇaṁ ।
tāṇaṁ ciya ahiyayaraṁ vāyābandhaṁ kulīṇassa ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.72
[nēhavajjāsnēhapaddhatiḥ]
candō dhavalijjaï puṇṇimāi aha puṇṇimā vi candēṇa ।
samasuhadukkhāi maṇē puṇṇēṇa viṇā na labbhanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.73
ēkkāi navari nēhō payāsiō tihuyaṇammi jōṇhāē ।
jā jhijjaï jhīṇē sasaharammi vaḍḍhēi vaḍḍhantē ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.74
jhijjaï jhīṇammi sayā vaḍḍhaï vaḍḍhantayammi savisēsaṁ ।
sāyarasasīṇa chajjaï jayammi paḍivannaṇivvahaṇaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.75
paḍivannaṁ jēṇa samaṁ puvvaṇiōēṇa hōi jīvassa ।
dūraṭiṭhaō na dūrē jaha candō kumuyasaṇḍāṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.76
dūraṭiṭhayā na dūrē sajjaṇacittāṇa puvvamiliyāṇaṁ ।
gayaṇaṭriṭhaō vi candō āsāsaï kumuyasaṇḍāiṁ ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.77
diṭṭhē vi hu hōi suhaṁ jaï vi na pāvanti aṅgasaṅgāiṁ ।
dūraṭṭhiō vi candō suṇivvuiṁ kuṇaï kumuyāṇaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.78
ēmēva kaha vi kassa vi kēṇa vi diṭṭhēṇa hōi pariōsō ।
kamalāyarāṇa raïṇā kiṁ kajjaṁ jēṇa viyasanti ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.79
kattō uggamaï raī kattō viyasanti paṅkayavaṇāiṁ ।
suyaṇāṇa jaē nēhō na calaï dūraṭṭhiyāṇaṁ pi ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.80
[nīivajjānītipaddhatiḥ]
jaṁ jassa mammamēyaṁ cālijjantaṁ ca dūmaē hiyayaṁ ।
taṁ tassa kaṇṇakaḍuyaṁ kulēsu jāyā na japāta ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.81
santēha asantēhi ya parassa kiṁ jampiēhi dōsēhiṁ ॥
atthō jasō na labbhaï sō vi amittō kaō hōi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.82
appahiyaṁ kāyavvaṁ jaï sakkaï parahiyaṁ ca kāyavvaṁ ।
appahiyaparahiyāṇaṁ appahiyaṁ cēva kāyavvaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.83
purisē saccasamiddhē aliyapamukkē sahāvasantuṭṭhē ।
tavadhammaṇiyamamaïē visamā vi dasā samā hōi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.84
sīlaṁ varaṁ kulāō dāliddaṁ bhavvayaṁ ca rōgāō ।
vijjā rajjāu varaṁ khamā varaṁ suṭṭhu vi tavāō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.85
sīlaṁ varaṁ kulāō kulēṇa kiṁ hōi vigayasīlēṇa ।
kamalāi kaddamē sambhavanti na hu hunti maliṇāiṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.86
jaṁ ji khamēi samatthō ghaṇavantō jaṁ na gavvamuvvahaï ।
jaṁ ca savijjō namirō tisu tēsu alaṅkiyā puhabī ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.87
chandaṁ jō aṇuvaṭṭaï mammaṁ rakkhaï guṇē payāsēi ।
sō navari māṇusāṇaṁ dēvāṇa vi vallahō hōi ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.88
chaṇavañcaṇēṇa varisō nāsaï divasō kubhōyaṇē bhuttē ।
kukalattēṇa ya jammō nāsaï dhammō ahammēṇa ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.89
channaṁ dhammaṁ payaḍaṁ ca pōrisaṁ parakalattavañcaṇayaṁ ।
gañjaṇarahiō jammō rāḍhāittāṇa sampaḍaï ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.90
[dhīravajjādhīrapaddhatiḥ]
appāṇaṁ amuyantā jē ārambhanti duggamaṁ kajjaṁ ।
paramuhapalōiyāṇaṁ tāṇaṁ kaha hōi jayalacchī ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.91
sigdhaṁ āruha kajjaṁ pāraddhaṁ mā kahaṁ pi siḍhilēsu ।
pāraddhasiḍhiliyāiṁ kajjāi puṇō na sijjhanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.92
acchaü tā iyarajaṇō aṅgē cciya jāi pañca bhūyāiṁ ।
tāhaṁ ciya lajjijjaï pāraddhaṁ pariharantēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.93
jhīṇavihavō vi suyaṇō sēvaï rannaṁ na patthaē annaṁ ।
maraṇē vi aïmahagdhaṁ na vikkiṇaï māṇamāṇikkaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.94
vē maggā bhuvaṇayalē māṇiṇi māṇunnayāṇa purisāṇaṁ ।
ahavā pāvanti siriṁ ahava bhamantā samappanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.95
bēṇṇi vi hunti gaīō sāhasavantāṇa dhīrapurisāṇaṁ ।
vēllahalakamalahatthā rāyasirī ahava pavvajjā ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.96
ahavā maranti guruvasaṇapēlliyā khaṇḍiūṇa niyajīhaṁ ।
nō gantūṇa khalāṇaṁ cavanti dīṇakkharaṁ dhīrā ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.97
aha suppaï piyamāliṅgiūṇa uttuṅgathōrathaṇavaṭṭhē ।
aha narakaraṅkakaṅkālasaṅkulē bhīsaṇamasāṇē ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.98
aha bhuñjaï saha piyakāmiṇīhi kaccōlathālasippīhiṁ ।
ahavā vimalakavālē bhikkhaṁ bhamiūṇa pēyavaṇē ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.99
namiūṇa jaṁ viḍhappaï khalacalaṇaṁ tihuyaṇaṁ pi kiṁ tēṇa ।
māṇēṇa jaṁ viḍhappaï taṇaṁ pi taṁ nivvuiṁ kuṇaï ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.100
tē dhannā tāṇa namō tē garuyā māṇiṇō thirārambhā ।
jē garuyavasaṇapaḍipēlliyā vi annaṁ na patthanti ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.101
tuṅgō cciya hōi maṇō maṇaṁsiṇō antimāsu vi dasāsu ।
atthantassa vi raïṇō kiraṇā uddhaṁ ciya phuranti ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.102
tā tuṅgō mērugirī mayaraharō tāva hōi duttārō ।
tā visamā kajjagaī jāva na dhīrā pavajjanti ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.103
tā vitthiṇṇaṁ gayaṇaṁ tāva cciya jalaharā aïgahīrā ।
tā garuyā kulasēlā jāva na dhīrēhi tullanti ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.104
mērū tiṇaṁ va saggō gharaṅgaṇaṁ hatthachittaṁ gayaṇayalaṁ ।
vāhaliyā ya samuddā sāhasavantāṇa purisāṇaṁ ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.105
saṅghaḍiyaghaḍiyavighaḍiyaghaḍantavighaḍantasaṅghaḍijjantaṁ ।
avahatthiūṇa divvaṁ karēi dhīrō samāraddhaṁ ॥ 16 ॥ // VajLag.106
[sāhasavajjāsāhasapaddhatiḥ]
sāhasamavalambantō pāvaï hiyaïcchiyaṁ na sandēhō ।
jēṇuttamaṅgamēttēṇa rāhuṇā kavaliō candō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.107
taṁ kiṁ pi sāhasaṁ sāhasēṇa sāhanti sāhasasahāvā ।
jaṁ bhāviūṇa divvō paraṁmuhō dhuṇaï niyasīsaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.108
tharatharaï dharā khubbhanti sāyarā hōi vimhalō1 daïvō ।
asamavavasāyasāhasasaṁladdhajasāṇa dhīrāṇaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.109
agaṇiyasamavisamāṇaṁ sāhasatuṅgē samāruhantāṇaṁ ।
rakkhaï dhīrāṇa maṇaṁ āsannabhayāulō daïvō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.110
taṁ kiṁ pi kammarayaṇaṁ dhīrā vavasanti sāhasavasēṇaṁ ।
jaṁ bambhahariharāṇa vi laggaï cittē camakkārō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.111
dhīrēṇa samaṁ samasīsiyāi rē divva āruhantassa ।
hōhii kiṁ pi kalaṅkaṁ dhuvvantaṁ jaṁ na phiṭiṭahii ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.112
jaha jaha na samappaï vihivasēṇa vihaḍantakajjapariṇāmō ।
taha taha dhīrāṇa maṇē vaḍḍhaï biuṇō samucchāhō ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.113
phalasampattīi samōṇayāi tuṅgāi phalavipattīē ।
hiyayāi supurisāṇaṁ mahātarūṇaṁ va siharāiṁ ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.114
hiyaē jāō tatthēva vaḍiḍhaō nēya payaḍiō lōē ।
vavasāyapāyavō supurisāṇa lakkhijjaï phalēhiṁ1 ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.115
vavasāyaphalaṁ vihavō vihavassa ya vihalajaṇasamuddharaṇaṁ ।
vihaluddharaṇēṇa jasō jasēṇa bhaṇa kiṁ na pajjattaṁ ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.116
āḍhattā sappurisēhi tuṅgavavasāyadinnahiyaēhiṁ ।
kajjārambhā hōhinti nipphalā kaha ciraṁ kālaṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.117
na mahumahaṇassa1 vacchē majjhē kamalāṇa nēya khīraharē ।
vavasāyasāyarē supurisāṇa lacchī phuḍaṁ vasaï ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.118
taddiyahārambhaviyāvaḍāṇa mittēkkakajjarasiyāṇaṁ ।
ravirahaturayāṇa va supurisāṇa na hu hiyayavīsāmō ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.119
[divvavajjādaivapaddhatiḥ]
atthō vijjā purisattaṇaṁ ca annāi guṇasahassāiṁ ।
divvāyattē kajjē savvāi narassa vihaḍanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.120
satthatthē paḍiyassa vi majjhēṇaṁ ēi kiṁ pi taṁ kajjaṁ ।
jaṁ na kahiuṁ na sahiuṁ na cēva pacchāiuṁ taraï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.121
jaï visaï visamavivaraṁ laṅghaï uyahiṁ karēi vavasāyaṁ ।
taha vi hu phalaṁ na pāvaï purisō divvē parāhuttē ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.122
nagghanti guṇā vihaḍanti bandhavā vallahā virajjanti ।
vavasāō na samappaï narassa divvē parāhuttē ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.123
jaṁ jaṁ ḍālaṁ lambaï hatthē gahiūṇa vīsamaï jattha ।
sā sā taḍatti tudr̥i narassa divvē parāhuttē ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.124
jaṁ nayaṇēhi na dīsaï hiyaēṇa vi jaṁ na cintiyaṁ kaha vi ।
taṁ taṁ sirambhi nivaḍaï narassa divvē parāhuttē ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.125
[vihivajjāvidhipaddhatiḥ]
khaṇḍijjaï vihiṇā sasaharō vi sūrassa hōi atthamaṇaṁ ।
hā divvapariṇaīē kavalijjaï kō na kālēṇaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.126
kō ēttha sayā suhiō kassa va lacchī virāi pēmmāiṁ ।
kassa va na hōi khalaṇaṁ bhaṇa kō hu na khaṇḍiō vihiṇā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.127
unnaya nīyā nīyā vi unnayā hunti takkhaṇa ccēva ।
vihipariṇāmiyakajjaṁ hariharabamhā na yāṇanti ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.128
vihiṇā jaṁ ciya lihiyaṁ nalāḍavaṭṭīi tēṇa daïvēṇa ।
pacchā sō vi pasannō annaha kariuṁ na hu samatthō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.129
kiṁ karaï kira varāō sāhasavavasāyamāṇagaruō vi ।
purisō bhaggapayāvō vihiṇā vivarīyarūvēṇa ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.130
bēṇṇi vi mahaṇārambhē pēcchaha jaṁ puvvakammapariṇāmō ।
uppajjaï haraï visaṁ kaṇhassa ghaṇatthaṇā lacchī ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.131
cihivihiyaṁ ciya labbhaï amayaṁ dēvāṇa mahumahē lacchī
rayaṇāyarammi mahiē harassa bhāē visaṁ jāyaṁ ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.132
[dīṇavajjādīnapaddhatiḥ]
parapatthaṇāpavannaṁ mā jaṇaṇi jaṇēsu ērisaṁ puttaṁ ।
uyarē vi mā dharijjasu patthaṇabhaṅgō kaō jēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.133
tā rūvaṁ tāva guṇā lajjā saccaṁ kulakkamō tāva ।
tāva cciya ahimāṇō dēhi tti nabhaṇṇaē jāva ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.134
tiṇatūlā vi hu lahuyaṁ dīṇaṁ daïvēṇa nimmiyaṁ bhuvēṇa ।
vāēṇa kiṁ na nīyaṁ appāṇaṁ patthaṇabhaēṇa ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.135
tharatharatharēi hiyayaṁ jīhā ghōlēi kaṇṭhamajjhammi ।
nāsaï muhalāvaṇṇaṁ dēhi tti paraṁ bhaṇantassa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.136
kisiṇijjanti layantā uyahijalaṁ jalaharā payattēṇa ।
dhavalīhunti hu dēntā dēntalayantantaraṁ pēccha ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.137
[dāriddavajjādāridrayapaddhatiḥ]
dāriddaya tujjha guṇā gōvijjantā vi dhīrapurisēhiṁ ।
pāhuṇaēsu chaṇēsu ya vasaṇēsu ya pāyaḍā hunti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.138
dāriddaya tujjha namō jassa pasāēṇa ērisī riddhī ।
pēcchāmi sayalalōē tē maha1 lōyā na pēcchanti ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.139
jē jē guṇiṇō jē jē vi māṇiṇō jē viyaḍḍhasaṁmāṇā ।
dālidda rē viyakkhaṇa tāṇa tumaṁ sāṇurāō si ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.140
dīsanti jōyasiddhā añjaṇasiddhā vi kē vi dīsanti ।
dāriddajōyasiddhaṁ maṁ tē lōyā na pēcchanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.141
jē bhaggā vihavasamīraṇēṇa vaṅkaṁ ṭhavanti payamaggaṁ ।
tē nūṇaṁ dāliddōsahēṇa jaï pañjalijjanti ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.142
kiṁ vā kulēṇa kīraï kiṁ vā viṇaēṇa kiṁ ca rūvēṇa ।
dhaṇarahiyāṇaṁ sundari narāṇa kō āyaraṁ kuṇaï ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.143
jāī rūvaṁ vijjā tinni vi gacchantu kandarē vivarē ।
atthō cciya parivaḍḍhaü jēṇa guṇā pāyaḍā hunti ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.144
dhammatthakāmarahiyā jē diyahā niddhaṇāṇa vōlīṇā ।
jaï tāi gaṇēi vihī gaṇēu na hu ērisaṁ juttaṁ ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.145
saṅkuyaï saṅkuyantē viyasaï viyasantayambhi sūrammi ।
sisirē rōrakuḍumbaṁ paṅkayalīlaṁ samuvvahaha ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.146
[pahuvajjāprabhupaddhatiḥ]
chajjaï pahussa laliyaṁ piyāi māṇō khamā samatthassa ।
jāṇantassa ya bhaṇiyaṁ mōṇaṁ ca ayāṇamāṇassa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.147
sacchandaṁ bōlijjaï kijjaï jaṁ niyamaṇassa paḍihāi ।
ajasassa na bīhijjaï pahuttaṇaṁ tēṁṇa ramaṇijjaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.148
jammadiṇē thaṇaṇivaḍaṇabhaēṇa dijjanti dhāiucchaṅgē ।
pahuṇō jaṁ nīyarayā mannē taṁ khīramāhappaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.149
hiṭṭhaṭṭhē jaḍaṇivahaṁ taha ya supattāi uttamaṅgēsu ।
jaha hōi tarū taha jaï pahuṇō tā kiṁ na pajjattaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.150
[sēvayavajjāsēvakapaddhatiḥ]
jaṁ sēvayāṇa dukkhaṁ cārittavivajjiyāṇa naraṇāha ।
taṁ hōu tuha riūṇaṁ ahavā tāṇaṁ pi mā hōu ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.151
bhūmīsayaṇaṁ jaracīrabandhaṇaṁ bambhacērayaṁ bhikkhā ।
muṇicariyaṁ duggayasēvayāṇa dhammō paraṁ natthi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.152
jaï nāma kaha vi sōkkhaṁ hōi tulaggēṇa sēvayajaṇassa ।
tēṁ khavaṇayasaggārōhaṇaṁ va viggōvayasaēhiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.153
ōlaggiō si dhammammi hōjja ēṇhiṁ narinda vaccāmō ।
ālihiyakuñjarassa va tuha pahu dāṇaṁ ciya na diṭṭhaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.154
āsannaphalō phaṇasō vva nāha sayalassa sēvayajaṇassa ।
amhaṁ puṇa patthiva patthiō vi tālō tumaṁ jāō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.155
phaṇasēṇa samaṁ mahimaṇḍalammi kā taruvarāṇa samasīsī ।
karikumbhasacchahaṁ maggaṇāṇa jō dēi phalaṇivahaṁ ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.156
varisihisi tumaṁ jalahara bharihisi bhuvaṇantarāi nīsēsaṁ ।
taṇhāsusiyasarīrē muyammi vappīhayakiḍumbē ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.157
dēhi tti kaha nu bhaṇṇaï supurisavavahārabāhiraṁ vayaṇaṁ ।
sēvijjaï viṇaēṇaṁ ēsa cciya patthaṇā lōē ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.158
bhuñjanti kasaṇaḍasaṇā abbhantarasaṇṭhiyā gaṁindassa ।
jē uṇa vihurasahāyā tē dhavalā bāhira ccēva ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.159
tambāu tinni supaōharāu cattāri pakkalabaïllā ।
nippannā rālayamañjarīu sēvā suhaṁ kuṇaü ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.160
savvō chuhiō sōhaï maḍhadēulamandiraṁ ca cañcarayaṁ ।
naraṇāha maha kuḍumbaṁ chuhachuhiyaṁ dubbalaṁ hōi ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.161
[suhaḍavajjāsubhaṭapaddhatiḥ]
jaṁ dijjaï paharaparavvasēhi mucchāgaēhi payamēkkaṁ ।
taha nēhassa payassa va na yāṇimō kō samabbhahi ō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.162
bhaggē vi balē valiē vi sāhaṇē sāmiē nirucchāhē ।
niyamuyavikkamasārā thakkanti kuluggayā suhaḍā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.163
viyalaï dhaṇaṁ na māṇaṁ jhijjaï aṅgaṁ na jhijjaï payāvō ।
rūvaṁ calaï na phuraṇaṁ siviṇē vi maṇaṁsisatthāṇaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.164
avamāṇiō vva saṁmāṇiō vva navasēvaō vva kuviō vva ।
paharaï kayāvarāhō vva nibbhaō kō vi saṅgāmē ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.165
uyarē asikappariē antōhē nivaḍiyammi calaṇēsu ।
bhamaï bhaḍō jasaluddhō sasaṅkalō mattahatthi vva ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.166
dāhiṇakarēṇa khaggaṁ vāmēṇa siraṁ dharēi nivaḍantaṁ ।
antāvēḍhiyacalaṇō jāi1 bhaḍō ēkkamēkkassa ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.167
ajja vi vihurō supahū ajja vi paharanti suhaḍasaṅghāyā ।
ajja vi majjhatthā jayasirī vi tā jīva mā vacca ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.168
nēcchaï saggaggamaṇaṁ kuvaï bhaḍō suravahūhi nijjantō ।
garuyapaḍivakkhapēlliyasāmiyakajjē aṇimmāē ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.169
ēkkō vi kō vi niyagōttabhūsaṇō dharaü jaṇaṇiuyarammi ।
jō riughaḍāṇa samuhō paraṁmuhō parakalattāṇaṁ ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.170
viyaḍaṁ sō parisakkaü sāmipasāyaṁ ca sō samuvvahaü ।
duvvāravērivāraṇaṇivāraṇā jassa bhuyadaṇḍā ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.171
ēkkaṁ dantammi payaṁ bīyaṁ kumbhammi taïyamalahantō ।
balibandhavilasiyaṁ mahumahassa ālambaē suhaḍō ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.172
calacamarakaṇṇacāliravijjijjantō bhaḍō gaïndēṇa ।
ō suvaï sāmikayakajjaṇibbharō dantapallaṅkē ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.173
gāḍhāsaṇassa kassa vi uyarē nihayassa maṇḍalaggēṇa ।
addhaṁ mahīi paḍiyaṁ turaṅgapiṭṭhiṭṭhiyaṁ addhaṁ ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.174
sabbhāvē pahuhiyaē jīē saggē jasē jaē sayalē ।
ṭhaviē raṇammi sīsē kayakajjō nacciō suhaḍō ॥ 14 ॥ // VajLag.175
chinnē raṇammi bahupahupasāyamālāpaḍicchirē sīsē ।
uttiṇṇagaruyabhāraṁ va nacciyaṁ naravarakabandhaṁ ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.176
pakkhāṇilēṇa pahuṇō viramaü muccha tti pāsapaḍiēṇa ।
giddhantakaḍḍhaṇaṁ dūsahaṁ pi sāhijjaï bhaḍēṇa ॥ 16 ॥ // VajLag.177
vacchatthalaṁ ca suhaḍassa rahirakuṅkumavilittayaṅgassa ।
varakāmiṇi vva cumbaï urē nisannā sivā vayaṇaṁ ॥ 17 ॥ // VajLag.178
[dhavalavajjādhavalapaddhatiḥ]
sañcuṇṇiyathōrajuyappahārasañjaṇiyagaruyakiṇasōhō ।
dhavalassa mahābharakaḍḍhaṇāi kandhō cciya kahēi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.179
aha maraï dhurālaggō sañcuṇṇiyasandhibandhaṇō dhavalō ।
na hu pāmarassa vihurē ārāparighaṭṭaṇaṁ sahaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.180
aha tōḍaï niyakandhaṁ aha kaḍḍhaï gurubharammi duvvōjjhaṁ ।
dhavalō dhurammi juttō na sahaï uccāriyaṁ hakkaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.181
cikvaṇacikkhallacahuṭṭacakkathakkē bharammi jāṇihisi ।
avisēsannaya gahavaï paraṁmuhō jaṁ si dhavalāṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.182
amuṇiyaguṇō na juppaï1 na muṇijjaï sa ya guṇō ajuttassa
thakkē bharē visūraï aüvvavaggaṁ gaō dhavalō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.183
sō cciya sayaḍē sō cciya halammi sō cciya vahēi piṭṭhīē ।
bahugōdhaṇō vi haliō nandaï ēkkēṇa dhavalēṇa ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.184
kattō labbhanti dhurandharāi dhavalāi bharasamatthāiṁ ।
aïvihurē gurubhāraṁ kaḍḍhanti ya līlamattāē ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.185
[viñjhavajjāvindhyapaddhatiḥ]
dantacchōhaṁ taḍaviyaḍamōḍaṇaṁ sarasapallavullihaṇaṁ ।
jaï viñjhō cciya na sahaï tā kariṇō kattha vaccanti ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.186
sā rēvā tāi pāṇiyāi tē ccēva kariṇisaṅghāyā ।
sā sallaï sallaï gayavarassa viñjhaṁ muyantassa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.187
viñjhēṇa viṇā vi gayā naravaïbhavaṇēsu gōravijjanti ।
viñjhō na hōi agaō gaēhi bahuēhi vi gaēhiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.188
gōmahisaturaṅgāṇaṁ pasūṇa savvāṇa jujjaē ṭhāṇaṁ ।
daḍḍhagaïndāṇa puṇō aha viñjhō aha mahārāō ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.189
[gayavajjāgajapaddhatiḥ]
viyaliyamaēṇa gayajōvvaṇēṇa hallantadantamusalēṇa ।
ajja vi vaṇaṁ saṇāhaṁ jūhāhiva paï jiyantēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.190
ajja vi sambharaï gaō majjantō saravarammi līlāē ।
jaṁ kariṇikaraggummūliēṇa pahaō muṇālēṇa ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.191
mā sumarasu candaṇapallavāṇa kariṇāha gēṇha tiṇakavalaṁ ।
jā jaha pariṇamaha dasā taṁ taha dhīrā paḍicchanti ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.192
mā jhijjasu aṇudiyahaṁ kariṇiviōēṇa mūḍha kariṇāha ।
sōkkhaṁ na hōi kassa vi nirantaraṁ ēttha saṁsārē ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.193
jāyāsuyavirahavisaṇṭhulassa jūhāhivassa viñjhammi ।
tē sarasapallavā sallaīi visakavalasāricchā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.194
garuyachuhāuliyassa ya vallahakariṇīsuhaṁ bharantassa ।
sarasō muṇālakavalō gayassa hatthē cciya vilīṇō ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.195
taha nīsasiyaṁ jūhāhivēṇa ciravilasiyaṁ bharantēṇa ।
karagahiyaṁ tiṇakavalaṁ hariyaṁ jaha jhatti pajjaliyaṁ ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.196
virahapalittō rē varagaïnda mā bhañja sayalavaṇarāī ।
ummūliē vi viñjhē virahāvatthā taha ccēya ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.197
jūhāō vaṇagahaṇaṁ gahaṇāu saraṁ sarāu girisiharaṁ ।
siharāhintō puhaviṁ niēi hatthī piyāvirahē ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.198
kariṇikarappiyaṇavasarasasallaīkavalabhōyaṇaṁ dantī ।

aṅgāraē paṇaṭṭhē sukkassa gaī taha ccēya ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.498
atthi ghara cciya gaṇaō vicittakaraṇēhi niṭṭhuraṁ gaṇaï ।

jōisiya kīsa cukkasi vicittakaraṇāi jāṇamāṇō vi ।
taha kaha vi kuṇasu sigghaṁ jaha sukkaṁ niccalaṁ hōi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.500
vivarīē raïbimbē nakkhattāṇaṁ ca ṭhāṇagahiyāṇaṁ ।
na paḍaï jalassa bindū sundari cittaṭiṭhaē sukkē ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.501
viulaṁ phalayaṁ thōrā salāyayā1 tuṁ pi gaṇaya kusalō si ।
taha vi na āō sukkō saccaṁ ciya sunnahiyaō si ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.502
ḍajjhaü sō jōisiō vicittakaraṇāi jāṇamāṇō vi ।
gaṇiuṁ sayavāraṁ mē uṭṭhaï dhūmō gaṇantassa ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.503
jaï gaṇasi puṇō vi tumaṁ vicittakaraṇēhi gaṇaya savisēsaṁ ।
sukkakkamēṇa2 rahiyaṁ na hu laggaṁ sōhaṇaṁ hōi ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.504
mōttūṇa karaṇagaṇiyaṁ aṅgulimēttēṇa jaï vi sō gaṇaï ।
aïṇiuṇō jōisiō kaḍḍhaï nāḍīgayaṁ sukkaṁ ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.505

aṅgārayaṁ na yāṇaï na hu bujjhaï hatthacittasañcāraṁ ।
iya māi kūḍagaṇaō kaha jāṇaï sukkasañcāraṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.507
[lēhayavajjālēkhakapaddhatiḥ]
masi maliūṇa na yāṇasi lēhaṇi gahiūṇa mūḍha khaliō si ।
ōsarasu kūḍalēhaya sulaliyapattaṁ viṇāsihisi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.508
ḍhaliyā ya masī bhaggā ya lēhaṇī kharaḍiyaṁ ca talavaṭṭaṁ ।

pihulaṁ masibhāyaṇayaṁ atthi masī vittharaṁ ca talavaṭṭaṁ ।
amhārisāṇa kajjē hayalēhaya lēhaṇī bhaggā ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.510
[vijjavajjāvaidyapaddhatiḥ]
vijja na ēsō jaraō na ya vāhī ēsa kō vi sambhūō ।
uvasamaï salōṇēṇaṁ viḍaṅgajōyāmayarasēṇaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.511
saccaṁ jaraē kusalō sarasuppannaṁ ya lakkhasē vāhiṁ ।
ēyaṁ puṇō vi aṅgaṁ vijja viḍaṅgēhi pannattaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.512
pukkārayaṁ paüñjasu bālāi rasubbhavāi vāhīē ।
ajjaṁ aṇajja nillajja vijja pējjāi na hu kajjaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.513
sāmā khāmā na sahēi maddaṇaṁ vijja kiṁ viyappēṇaṁ ।
aggaṅgulīi dijjaü avalēhō māuliṅgassa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.514
pukkāraēṇa vijjaya nivviṇṇā tuha ya dīhasāsēṇa ।
mā vārijjaü bālā bhuñjaü annaṁ jahicchāē ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.515
gahavaïsuēṇa bhaṇiyaṁ aüvvavijjattaṇaṁ hayāsēṇaṁ
jēṇa paüñjaï pukkārayaṁ pi pannattiyāṇaṁ pi ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.516
vijja tuhāgamaṇa cciya mukkā jaraēṇa kiṁ na parimuṇasi ।
tā niyasu majjha aṅgē sampaï sēō samuppannō ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.517
vijjaya annaṁ vāraṁ maha jaraō sayaraēṇa pannattō ।
jaï taṁ1 nēcchasi dāuṁ tā kiṁ chāsī vi mā hōu ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.518
bālaṁ jarāvilaṅgiṁ kalamahurapalāviṇiṁ niyantassa ।
vijjassa sūsuō sūsuō vi sahasatti pannaṭṭhō ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.519
mōttūṇa bālatantaṁ taha ya vasīkaraṇamantatantēhiṁ ।
siddhatthēhi mahammaï taruṇī taruṇēṇa vijjēṇa ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.520
annaṁ na ruccaï cciya majjha piyāsāi pūriyaṁ hiyayaṁ ।
nēhasurayallayaṅgē tuha surayaṁ vijja paḍihāi ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.521
[dhammiyavajjādhārmikapaddhatiḥ]
jō dhammiō na pāvaï kurayaṁ mandārayaṁ ca muggarayaṁ ।
sō gahiyakaraṇḍō cciya kattō dhuttīrayaṁ1 lahaï ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.522
dhuttīraēṇa dhammiya jaï icchasi liṅgapūraṇaṁ kāuṁ ।
tā ējjasu majjha 2parōhaḍammi sūrammi atthamiē ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.523
dhuttīrayassa kajjē gahirāṇi parōhaḍāi vaccantō ।
dhammiya suraṅgakāō kurayāṇa vi navari cukkihisi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.524
dhuttīrayāṇa kajjēṇa dhammiō paraparōhaḍē bhamaï ।
annēhi viluppantaṁ niyayārāmaṁ na lakkhēi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.525
ghēttūṇa karaṇḍaṁ bhamaï vāvaḍō paraparōhaḍē nūṇaṁ ।
dhuttīraēsu rattō ēkkaṁ pi na mēllaē dhammī ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.526
sulahāi parōhaḍasaṇṭhiyāi dhuttīrayāṇi mōttūṇaṁ ।
kurayāṇa kaē raṇṇaṁ pēcchaha kaha dhammiō bhamaï ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.527
kañcīraēhi kaṇavīraēhi dhuttīraēhi bahuēhi ।
jaï icchasi dēharayaṁ dhammiya tā maha gharē ējja ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.528
mandārayaṁ vivajjaï kurayaṁ pariharaï cayaï bhaṅgarayaṁ ।
dhuttīrayamalahantō gahiyakaraṇḍō gaṇō bhamaï ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.529
viyasiyamuhāi vaṇṇujjalāi mayarandapāyaḍillāiṁ ।
dhuttīrayāi dhammiya puṇṇēhi viṇā na labbhanti ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.530
ēkkēṇa vi jaha dhuttīraēṇa liṅgassa uvari laggēṇa ।
mandārayāṇa dhammiya kōḍīi na taṁ suhaṁ hōi ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.531
sisiramayarandapajjharaṇapaürapasarantaparimalullāiṁ ।
kaṇavīrayāi gēṇhasu dhabhmiya sabbhāvarattāiṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.532
[jantiyavajjāyāntrikapaddhatiḥ]
jantiya gulaṁ vimaggasi na ya mē icchāi vāhasē jantaṁ ।
arasanna kiṁ na yāṇasi na rasēṇa viṇā gulaṁ hōi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.533
viyaḍā vi jantavāyā maüō nālō rasāulō ucchū ।
laṭṭhī vi1 suppamāṇā kiṁ jantiya ūṇayaṁ vahasi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.534
saddālayaṁ sarūvaṁ vitthiṇṇaṁ vararasaṁ sumaddasahaṁ ।
jaṁ2 ērisayaṁ jantaṁ tattha suhaṁ jantiō lahaï ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.535
taha jantiēṇa jantaṁ akkantaṁ nēhaṇibbhararasēṇa ।
jaha paḍhamaṁ ciya kuṇḍī bhariyā ēkkēṇa ghāēṇa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.536
taṁ jantaṁ sā kuṇḍī sō ucchū bahalapattalacchāō ।
pīlāvaya tujjha guṇō ajja vi ūṇō rasō jāō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.537
[musalavajjāmusalāpaddhatiḥ]
candaṇavaliyaṁ diḍhakañcibandhaṇaṁ dīharaṁ suparimāṇaṁ ।
hōi gharē sāhīṇaṁ musalaṁ dhannāṇa mahilāṇaṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.538
thōragaruyāi 1sundarakañcījuttāi hunti niyagēhē ।
dhannāṇa mahiliyāṇaṁ ukkhalasarisāi musalāiṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.539
muhabhāriyāi suṭṭhu vi suṭṭhu vi kañcīi diḍhanibaddhāiṁ ।
annāhiṁ pi hu juṇṇukkhalammi bhajjanti musalāiṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.540
bhamiō ciraṁ asēsō gāmō maï sahiyaō sayaṁ vāraṁ ।
gēhukkhalaparimāṇēṇa māmi musalaṁ ciya na diṭṭhaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.541
bhaddamuhamaṇḍaṇaṁ ciya darapihulaṁ taha ya kañcisōhillaṁ ।
annēsiṁ piya1 musalaṁ paḍichandaṁ tēṇa vaccāmō ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.542
[bālāsaṁvaraṇavajjābālāsaṁvaraṇapaddhatiḥ]
jassa tumaṁ aṇurattā sō tujjha ya mandahaṇēhaō putti ।
na hu dijjaï tālī dīharacchi ēkkēṇa hatthēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.543
jattha gaō tattha gaō sāmali sīhō na juppaï halammi ।
sappurisō vi taha cciya puṁsasu nayaṇāi mā ruṇṇaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.544
taïyā vārijjantī piyali1 païṁ ullirīhi acchīhiṁ ।
ēṇhiṁ virahāvatthaṁ puṇō vahantī kilāmihisi ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.545
mā ruvasu putti chēyāṇa aggaē khijjihinti nayaṇāiṁ ।
na hu khijjaï tāṇa maṇaṁ sēllaṁ miva salilapūrēṇaṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.546
dāṇaṁ na dēnti bahulaṁ nēhaṁ darisanti nēya rajjanti ।
gēṇhanti na dēnti maṇaṁ putti cchēyā durārāhā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.547
rajjanti1 nēya kassa vi rattā pasayacchi na hu virajjanti1 ।
diṇayarakara vva chēyā adiṭṭhadōsā vi rajjanti1 ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.548
rajjāvanti2 na rajjahim̐3 haranti hiyayaṁ na dēnti niyahiyayaṁ ।
chēyā bhuyaṅgasarisā ḍasiūṇa paraṁmuhā hōnti ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.549
rajjāvanti2 na rajjahim̐3 dēnti asōkkhaṁ na dukkhiyā hunti ॥
asuyaviṇaya tti ēṇhiṁ dukkhārāhā jaē chēyā ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.550
rattē rattā kasaṇammi kasaṇayā dhavalayammi taha dhavalā ।
phalihamaṇi vva chaïllā hunti jaṇē putti sampuṇṇā ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.551
[kuṭṭiṇīsikkhāvajjākuṭṭinīśikṣāpaddhatiḥ]
darahasiyakaḍakkhaṇirikkhaṇāi siṅgārakammamasiṇāiṁ ।
ēyāi puṇō sikkhasu niruvamasōhaggadaïyāiṁ ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.552
maggantī mūliyamūliyāi mā bhamasu gharaharaṁ putti ।
chandāṇuvattaṇaṁ piyayamassa ēvaṁ vasītakaṇaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.553
bhūsaṇapasāhaṇāḍambarēhi mā khivasu1 putti appāṇaṁ ।
rañjijjaï jēṇa jaṇō anna cciya tē alaṅkārā ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.554
annāsattē vi piē ahiyayaraṁ āyaraṁ kuṇijjāsu ।
uddhacchi vēyaṇāi vi namanti cariyāi vi guṇēhiṁ ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.555
na viṇā sabbhāvēṇaṁ ghēppaï paramatthajāṇaō lōō ।
kō juṇṇamañjaraṁ kañjiēṇa vēyāriuṁ taraï ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.556
jēṇa viṇā na valijjaï1 aṇuṇijjaï sō kayāvarāhō vi ।
patta vi nayaradāhē bhaṇa kassa na vallahō aggī ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.557
avvō jāṇāmi ahaṁ tumha pasāēṇa cāḍuyasayāiṁ ।
ēkkaṁ navari na jāṇē niṇṇēhē2 ramaṇapajjharaṇaṁ ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.558
tāva cciya ḍhalahalayā jāva cciya nēhapūriyasarīrā ।
siddhatthā uṇa chēyā nēhavihūṇā khalīhunti ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.559
[vēsāvajjāvēśyāpaddhatiḥ]
ahiṇi vva kuḍilagamaṇā rōraharē dīvaya vva niṇṇēhā ।
sukaï vva atthaluddhā vēsaṁ daṭaṭhūṇa vandāmi ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.560
vaṇṇaḍḍhā muharasiyā nēhavihūṇā vi laggaē kaṇṭhaṁ ।
pacchā karaï viyāraṁ balahaṭṭuyasārisā vēsā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.561
sahaï salōhā ghaṇaghāyatāḍaṇaṁ taha ya bāṇasambandhaṁ ।
kuṇṭhi vva paürakuḍilā vēsā muṭṭhīi saṁvahaï ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.562
jāō piyaṁ piyaṁ paï ēkkaṁ vijjhāiṁ taṁ ciya palittaṁ ।
hōi avaraṭṭhiō cciya vēsāsatthō tiṇaggi vava ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.563
nimmalapavittahārā bahulōhā pulaïēṇa aṅgēṇa ।
khaggalaïya vva vēsā kōsēṇa viṇā na saṁvahaï ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.564
dhaṇasañcayā1 sugujjhā nibaddhalōhā bhuyaṅgamahaṇijjā ।
mañjūsiya vva vēsā ṭhāṇaṁ ciya lōhavittassa ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.565
na gaṇēi rūpavantaṁ na kulīṇaṁ nēya rūvasampannaṁ ।
vēsā vāṇarisarisā jattha phalaṁ tattha saṅkamaï ॥ 7 ॥ // VajLag.566
annannarāyarasiyaṁ āsannapaōharaṁ guṇavihūṇaṁ ।
ṭhaḍḍhaṁ sahāvavaṅkaṁ vēsāhiyayaṁ suradhaṇu vva ॥ 8 ॥ // VajLag.567
kavaḍēṇa ramanti jaṇaṁ piyaṁ payampanti atthalōhēṇa ।
tāṇa namō vēsāṇaṁ appā vi na vallahō jāṇa ॥ 9 ॥ // VajLag.568
kulalañchaṇaṁ akittī atthassa khaō asīlasaṁvāsō ।
gantuṁ ciya vēsaharaṁ na jujjaē paṇḍiyajaṇassa ॥ 10 ॥ // VajLag.569
sampattiyāi kālaṁ gamēsu sulahāi appamullāē ।
dēulavāḍayapattaṁ tuṭṭaṇa sīlaṁ aïmahagdhaṁ ॥ 11 ॥ // VajLag.570
vēsāṇa kavaḍasayapūriyāṇa sabbhāvaṇēharahiyāṇaṁ ।
attharahiō na ruccaï pañcakkhō kāmadēvō vi ॥ 12 ॥ // VajLag.571
atthassa kāraṇēṇaṁ cumbanti muhāi vaṅkavirasāiṁ ।
appā vi jāṇa vēsō kō tāṇa parō piō hōi ॥ 13 ॥ // VajLag.572
supamāṇā ya susuttā bahurūvā taha ya kōmalā sisirē ।

kuḍilattaṇaṁ ca vaṅkattaṇaṁ ca vañcattaṇaṁ asaccaṁ ca ।
annāṇa hunti dōsā vēsāṇa puṇō alaṅkārā ॥ 15 ॥ // VajLag.574
sarasā nihasaṇasārā gandhaḍḍhā bahubhuyaṅgaparimaliyā1 ।
candaṇalaya vva vēsā bhaṇa kassa na vallahā hōi ॥ 16 ॥ // VajLag.575
mā jāṇaha maha suhayaṁ vēsāhiyayaṁ samammaṇullāvaṁ ।
sēvālalittapattharasarisaṁ paḍaṇēṇa jāṇihisi ॥ 17 ॥ // VajLag.576
ēkkaṁ khāyaï maḍayaṁ annaṁ ca kaḍakkharakkhiyaṁ dharaï ।
annassa dēi diṭṭhiṁ masāṇasivasārisā vēsā ॥ 17 ॥ // VajLag.577
gahiūṇa sayalaganthaṁ mōkkhaṁ jhāyanti taggayamaṇāō ।
vēsā muṇisāricchā niccaṁ ciya kavaliyāhatthā ॥ 19 ॥ // VajLag.578

atthā kiṁ kiviṇatthā satthāvatthā suyanti vva ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.579
nihaṇanti dhaṇaṁ dharaṇīyalammi iya jāṇiūṇa kiviṇajaṇā ।
pāyālē gantavvaṁ tā gacchaü aggaṭhāṇaṁ pi ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.580
kariṇō hariṇaharaviyāriyassa dīsanti mōttiyā kumbhē ।
kiviṇāṇa navari maraṇē payaḍa cciya hunti bhaṇḍārā ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.581
parimusaï karayalēṇa vi pēcchaï acchīhi taṁ sayā kiviṇō ।
ālihiyabhittibāullayaṁ va na hu bhuñjiuṁ taraï ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.582
pucchijjantā niyapariyaṇēṇa payaḍanti nēya taṁ atthaṁ ।
santaṁ pi dhaṇaṁ natthi tti jē bhaṇanti1 tē mahādhīrā ॥ 5 ॥ // VajLag.583
atthaṁ dharanti viyalā na dēnti pūyanti sayalabhūyāiṁ ।
puṇṇakkhaēṇa jhijjaï na sampayā cāyabhōēṇa ॥ 6 ॥ // VajLag.584
dēmi na kassa vi jampaï uddārajaṇassa viviharayaṇāiṁ ।
cāēṇa viṇā vi narō puṇō vi lacchīi pammukkō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.585

chuhaï daḍhaṁ kuddālaṁ aïgamaṇē āulaṁ va pēllēi ।
vilihaï dō vi taḍīō āṇaï hiyapāṇiyaṁ uḍḍō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.586
sirajāṇuē1 niuttō uḍḍō hatthēṇa khaṇaṇakusalēṇa ।
kuddālēṇa ya rahiyaṁ kaha uḍḍō āṇaē uyayaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.587
niddayakuddālayamajjha2 bahulucchalantajalasōttaṁ ।
uḍḍō laddhappharisō bhariyaṁ pi na mēllaē vāviṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.588
kuddālaghāyaghaṇatāḍaṇēṇa pajjharaï vasuha na hu cōjjaṁ ।
sō uḍḍō jassa vi dasaṁṇēṇa vaḍavā jalaṁ dēi ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.589

kaṇhō jayaï juvāṇō rāhā ummattajōvvaṇā jayaï ।
jaüṇā bahulataraṅgā tē diyahā tēttiya1 ccēva ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.592

saccaṁ ciya nēhaṇirandhalēhi dōsā na dīsanti ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.593

attā māyandaṇihīṇa kiṁ pi kumarīu sikkhavaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.559-2
[vēsāvajjā]
amuṇiyajammuppattī savvagayā bahubhuyaṅgaparimaliyā ।
mayaṇaviṇāsaṇasīlā harō vva vēsā suhaṁ dēu ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.578-1
savvaṅgarāgarattaṁ daṁsaï kaṇavīrakusumasāricchaṁ ।
gabbhē kaha vi na rattaṁ vēsāhiyayaṁ taha ccēva ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.578-2
[kaṇhavajjā]
uvvūḍhabhuvaṇabhārō vi kēsavō thaṇaharēṇa rāhāē ।
mālaïdala vva kaliō lahuijjaï kō na pēmmēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.605-1
taha ruṇṇaṁ tīi taḍaṭṭhiyāi rāhāi kaṇhavirahammi ।
jaha sē kajjalamaïlaṁ ajja vi jaüṇājalaṁ vahaï ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.605-2
[hiyālīvajjā]
chīē jīva na bhaṇiyaṁ pariyaṇamajjhammi pōḍhamahilāē ।
chōḍēi cihurabhāraṁ puṇa baddhaṁ kēṇa kajjēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.624-1
kulabāliyā pasūyā puttavaī surayakajjatattillā ।
ērisaguṇasampannā bhaṇa kīsa na vāsiyā païṇā ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.624-2

[vasantavajjā]
laṅkālaēṇa rattambaravēsiṇa dinnapupphayāṇēṇa ।
dahavayaṇēṇēva kayaṁ sīyāharaṇaṁ palāsēṇa ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.637-1
guruvirahasandhiviggahaṇimmavaṇō atthi kō vi jaï mattō ।
paḍhamikkamañjariṁ aṅguliṁ va ubbhēi sahayārō ॥ 1 ॥ // VajLag.641-1
cañcupuḍakōḍiviyaliyamāyandarasōhasittadēhassa ।
kīrassa maggalaggaṁ bhamaraülaṁ bhamaï gandhaḍḍhaṁ ॥ 2 ॥ // VajLag.641-2
saccaṁ cēva palāsō asaï palaṁ virahiyāṇa mahumāsē ।
tittiṁ avaccamāṇō jalaï vva chuhāi savvaṅgaṁ ॥ 3 ॥ // VajLag.641-3
suhiyāṇa suhañjaṇayā dukkhañjaṇayā ya dukkhiyajaṇassa ।
ēē sōhañjaṇayā sōhañjaṇayā vasantassa ॥ 4 ॥ // VajLag.641-4
